title: CraftCommand: Diagnostic Intelligence & Backup Hardening
notes: Diagnosis Intelligence: 6 new rules for mod corruption, datapack errors, and network conflicts.
Auto-Healing: Advanced recovery actions including automated corrupted mod removal.
Version Expansion: Native support for Minecraft 1.21.11 and legacy 1.7.10-1.19.2 environments.
Backup Hardening: Implemented concurrency locking and robust randomized ID generation.
Retention Logic: Intelligent snapshot management with Auto-Save protection and GFS policy.
